text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
At last... at long last! Falco's Make 
Debut☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Haaah~! My very first Winning Live...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what will happen? What's it gonna 
feel like?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be... could I be standing at 
center stage right from the start~!?"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Still, if I'm not talking, I just end up 
getting nervous, you know~...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe there's a chance it won't work 
out at all after all...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon has the mental fortitude to 
put on a concert even with zero audience, 
but running seems to be a different story.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Do you really think so? Do you think... 
Falco can win on dirt?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
The first step toward becoming a top 
umadol! I'm off with my boosters at full 
blast☆
